summary: 多币种汇率反查/对账后续 on BASE c931137. Implements PH-388 on top of PH-321 FxRateSnapshot without a new owner/table or core migration: fx_rate_history returns exact business-date history by currency pair/source/version, keeps all same-date versions, reports fx_rate_exact_date_missing with no fallback, and rejects future rates for historical use; trace_fx_ref validates immutable refs and effective date against the business date; fx_reconciliation produces read-only original/book/rate consistency rows for contract lines, active settlements and invoices, with null+missing semantics, conversion mismatch/issue reporting, pm project scope and member denial. The existing /modules/contracts/fx-rates/ page is extended with history filters and reconciliation tables (no new route; route binding unchanged and remains inside the PH-388 allowlist). Tests (10) cover exact-date/versions/no fallback, future rejection, permissions/module-disabled history, contract conversion pass/mismatch, invoice CNY-only schema missing explicit, settlement CNY reconciliation, and pm/cross-org/member boundaries. L3 CI/PostgreSQL, L4 browser and L5 production are not_run; invoice has no original currency/FX fields so it is honestly reported missing rather than fabricated; no release/product-level pass is claimed. No core migration/table/route/product change beyond allowlisted contracts FX files/tests.

findings: EXACT-DATE/TRACE SEMANTICS: fx_rate_history filters by exact effective_on, keeps all same-day versions, returns fx_rate_exact_date_missing when the exact date has no rate and never falls back; future exact dates are rejected. trace_fx_ref resolves the immutable ref and rejects a rate whose effective date is later than the supplied business date. Both are read-only and derive no new canonical facts.
